text:
Evelyn (VP People): Thanks everyone for coming to the all-hands. Quick follow-up: posting answers and clarifications about the org changes and how the talent moves will work. Ask here if anything's unclear.
Sam (Eng Mgr): Appreciate it. Two quick ones: 1) timeline for manager reassignments? 2) will teams get any headcount buffer to cover gaps during transitions?
Evelyn (VP People): Timeline: most reassignments will be effective at the start of next pay period (2 weeks). We plan a 30-day overlapping handoff window for critical roles. Buffer: temporary contractor approvals (up to 90 days) are pre-authorized for teams with customer-facing SLAs.
Ravi (Staff SWE): For folks who are offered transfers, is leveling recalculated or do they keep current level? Also, how will bonus/comp cycles be impacted?
Evelyn (VP People): Transfers keep the current level by default. If the new role's scope differs, comp team will review and communicate adjustments before offer acceptance. Bonus cycles remain with the original team until the next normal payout — we'll prorate where needed.
Mia (Recruiter): I'll post an internal mobility doc in #devex after this. Quick note: internal candidates will get prioritized interview slots for the next 4 weeks. Please ping me for scheduling windows.
Jordan (Product): Does the roadmap change for Q2? Are we cutting any major initiatives because of these moves?
Evelyn (VP People): Roadmap: Product leadership prioritized a small set of mission-critical items; you should see a short update from Jordan and Priya by EOD. No wholesale cuts, but some features are being staged to later milestones.
Priya (Platform): From a capacity standpoint: Dedicated pools won't be reduced for customer tiers. However, some infra-focused hiring is delayed by one quarter. We'll provide a list of affected roles and suggested mitigation (ops rotations, triage pairing).
Sam (Eng Mgr): How should we handle interview loops for internal transfers? Shorter loop? Less onsite component?
Mia (Recruiter): Internal loops: 1 technical interview + one org-fit + hiring manager final. No onsite. We can waive take-home tests on a case-by-case basis.
Ravi (Staff SWE): Any guidance on career conversations for ICs worried about growth after the move?
Evelyn (VP People): Managers should do 1:1 career check-ins within 2 weeks of transition. We'll also run a careers workshop next month (calendar invite to go out).
Jordan (Product): Request: can leadership share the prioritization rubric used for staffing decisions? Helps teams understand tradeoffs.
Evelyn (VP People): Yes — sharing rubric tomorrow. High level: customer impact, revenue-critical paths, cross-team dependencies, and long-term platform health.
Sam (Eng Mgr): One more: relocation/hybrid expectations if someone's role moves teams geographically?
Evelyn (VP People): Relocation: we are not requiring moves. If a role's primary office changes and the person chooses to relocate, relocation assistance will follow policy (same as standard offer). Remote/hybrid choices remain available per team guidelines.
Priya (Platform): Ops question: who owns on-call during overlaps?
Sam (Eng Mgr): We usually split ownership during handoff.
Priya (Platform): Agreed — we'll document a 7-14 day paired on-call handoff window for services with SLOs.
DevX-Bot: Reminder: internal mobility doc posted by @Mia in #devex — link: https://intranet.redwood/talent/mobility (automated).
Mia (Recruiter): I'll also send a short FAQ for managers on how to run 1:1s and update job postings. If you want visibility into the openings for your team, DM me.
Ravi (Staff SWE): Thanks. One nit: can we get clarity on how ICs are prioritized vs external hires for critical infra roles?
Mia (Recruiter): Short answer: internal candidates get priority for lateral moves and promotions where skills match. For roles requiring specialized experience we may open external searches in parallel. We'll put specifics in the doc.
Jordan (Product): Thanks — helpful. Can we get a single shared spreadsheet of role owners and timelines?
Evelyn (VP People): Yes — I'll ask People Ops to publish a tracker by EOD tomorrow.
Sam (Eng Mgr): Cool. If anything urgent pops up, DM me or Sam (Eng Mgr) here. :thumbsup:
Evelyn (VP People): Thanks all — we'll follow up with the rubric, mobility doc, and tracker. Reach out if you need one-off exceptions.
Mia (Recruiter): Posting now.
Priya (Platform): Leaving notes for infra teams.
Ravi (Staff SWE): Appreciate the quick answers.
DevX-Bot: Event: Careers workshop scheduled for 2026-04-05 10:00 (calendar invite sent)
